newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Austrim in A$53 mln textile firm buy.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Austrim in A$53 mln textile firm buy.

text.p: Austrim Ltd said on Wednesday it had agreed to acquire the businesses and certain properties of the Calum textiles manufacturing and processing group for A$53 million, subject to certain conditions.
The company also said it would assume certain liabilities that total about A$23 million.

Austrim said it would acquire the businesses and assets of Calum Textiles Pty Ltd, Melba Industries (Australia) Pty Ltd and Genevieve Yarn Dyers Pty Ltd for about A$33 million plus certain trade creditors and liabilities anticipated to be about A$23 million.
It said it would also acquire two freehold properties for a total of A$20 million.
Caprice Australia Pty Ltd, the curtain and household furnishing business of the Calum group, would remain with the current Calum shareholders.
Austrim said the Calum operations it had acquired achieved sales of about A$126 million in 1995/96 and earnings before interest and tax of about A$1.1 million.
It said Melba Industries was Australia's largest manufacturer of upholstery fabrics for the automotive industry while the Calum Textiles business was Australia's leading producer of knitted fabrics.
The Genevieve Yarn Dyers business specialised in yarn dyeing including textured polyester yarns for hosiery, webbing, vertical blinds, circular knitting and warp knitting.

Austrim said it had also agreed to buy the Calum Group's 25 percent interest in the recently established automotive textiles manufacturing joint venture in India which are under construction in the state of Rajasthan.
The acquisition is expected to be completed on or about March 31.

"This is a further step in the directors' stated desire to create a growth stock through increased earnings per share and dividends, resulting in an increased market capitalisation," Austrim chairman Alan Jackson said.
